subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class channel chat `/agent <id>` command that temporarily rebinds the current conversation to a configured agent, or keep chat-side switching limited to existing `/focus` subagent/ACP/session flows?
rationale: The requested command is useful but changes who can route a live channel conversation across agent workspaces, auth profiles, session stores, memory, sandbox rules, and tool permissions, so automation should not choose that boundary.

options.title: Add guarded `/agent` switching
options.body: Implement a channel command backed by existing conversation-binding route resolution, restricted to an explicit allow policy and covered by fresh-install plus upgrade/security tests.

options.title: Keep `/focus` as the channel path
options.body: Treat configured-agent switching from chat as out of scope for now and document `/focus`/`/agents` as the supported session-binding surface.

options.title: Defer to a broader routing design
options.body: Hold this issue for a larger multi-agent/channel command design that settles policy, UX, and transport differences together.

recommendation.title: Add guarded `/agent` switching
recommendation.body: Implement a channel command backed by existing conversation-binding route resolution, restricted to an explicit allow policy and covered by fresh-install plus upgrade/security tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans command contracts, multi-agent product boundaries, and security-sensitive session routing where recent history points to steipete's registry/docs ownership.
